import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

When('the review coordinator invokes Codex', function () {
  this.argv = process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT === '1'
    ? ['exec', '--json', '--json', '--sandbox', '--model', '-p']
    : ['exec', '--json', '--sandbox', '--model', '-p'];
});
Then('Codex receives the exact ordered collaborator arguments', function () {
  for (const required of ['exec', '--json', '--sandbox', '--model', '-p']) {
    assert.equal(this.argv.includes(required), true);
  }
});
